<!-- Shared by the English and Spanish contribute pages. -->
<p class="lead-sm" data-t="contributeIntro"></p>

<form id="submit-form" novalidate>
  <label for="dois" data-t="doisLabel"></label>
  <p class="form-hint" id="dois-hint" data-t="doisHint"></p>
  <textarea id="dois" name="dois" rows="4" aria-describedby="dois-hint" spellcheck="false"
    placeholder="10.5061/dryad.abc123&#10;https://doi.org/10.1111/btp.12345"></textarea>
  <ul id="doi-list" class="doi-list" aria-live="polite"></ul>
  <p id="too-many" class="form-alert" hidden></p>

  <label for="sector" data-t="sectorPick"></label>
  <select id="sector" name="sector">
    <option value=""></option>
    <option>Santa Rosa</option><option>Murciélago</option><option>Pocosol</option>
    <option>Junquillal</option><option>Horizontes</option><option>Guanacaste</option>
    <option>Rincón de la Vieja</option><option>Pitilla</option><option>Cacao</option>
    <option>Maritza</option><option>San Cristóbal</option><option>Del Oro</option>
    <option>Santa Elena</option><option>Marino</option><option>Other / Otro</option>
  </select>

  <label for="note" data-t="note"></label>
  <p class="form-hint" id="note-hint" data-t="noteHint"></p>
  <textarea id="note" name="note" rows="3" maxlength="1000" aria-describedby="note-hint"></textarea>

  <label for="contact" data-t="contact"></label>
  <input id="contact" name="contact" type="email" maxlength="200" autocomplete="email">

  <!-- Turnstile only shows itself if it needs the visitor to do something -->
  <div class="cf-turnstile mt-3" data-sitekey="0x4AAAAAAFj54k2qSoWe4-yj" data-appearance="interaction-only"></div>
  <button type="submit" id="submit-btn" class="btn btn-primary mt-3" disabled></button>
  <p id="status" class="form-alert" role="alert" hidden></p>
</form>

<section id="done" class="done-panel" tabindex="-1" hidden>
  <h2 data-t="doneTitle"></h2>
  <p id="done-text"></p>
  <ul id="done-list" class="doi-list"></ul>
  <button type="button" id="again" class="btn btn-outline-primary" data-t="again"></button>
</section>

<script src="https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js" async defer></script>
<script type="module">
import { strings } from "/assets/strings.js";
import { fmt } from "/assets/catalog.js";
const WORKER = "https://acg-catalog-submit.catherine-hulshof.workers.dev";
const MAX = 25;   // same as MAX_BATCH in worker/src/index.js
const lang = document.documentElement.lang === "en" ? "en" : "es";
const t = strings[lang];
document.querySelectorAll("[data-t]").forEach(el => el.textContent = t[el.dataset.t]);
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const esc = s => String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]));

// Every DOI in whatever was pasted: bare, "doi:" or doi.org links, any separators
function extractDois(text) {
  const found = (text.match(/10\.\d{4,9}\/[^\s"'<>,;]+/gi) || []).map(d => {
    d = d.replace(/[.]+$/, "");
    while (d.endsWith(")") && (d.match(/\)/g) || []).length > (d.match(/\(/g) || []).length) d = d.slice(0, -1);
    return d.toLowerCase();
  });
  return [...new Set(found)];
}

// Entries already published, so people don't submit them again
const published = Promise.all(["catalog", "papers"].map(f =>
  fetch(`data/${f}.json`).then(r => r.json()).catch(() => []))).then(([data, papers]) =>
  new Map([...data, ...papers].filter(d => d.doi).map(d => [d.doi.toLowerCase(), d])));

// doi -> { state: checking | ready | inAtlas | already | notFound, meta, status }
const items = new Map();

async function check(doi) {
  const have = (await published).get(doi);
  if (have) return { state: "inAtlas", meta: { title: have.title } };
  try {
    const r = await fetch(`${WORKER}/api/resolve?doi=${encodeURIComponent(doi)}`);
    const j = await r.json();
    if (!j.ok) return { state: "notFound" };
    if (j.already) return { state: "already", meta: j.metadata, status: j.already };
    return { state: "ready", meta: j.metadata };
  } catch { return { state: "notFound" }; }
}

function row(doi, it) {
  const m = it.meta || {};
  const kind = m.is_dataset ? `<span class="chip kind-dataset">${t.kindDatasetChip}</span>`
                            : `<span class="chip kind">${t.kindPaperChip}</span>`;
  const names = (m.creators || "").split("; ").filter(Boolean);
  const who = names.length > 3 ? names.slice(0, 3).join("; ") + " et al." : names.join("; ");
  const line = [who, m.year, m.publisher].filter(Boolean).map(esc).join(" · ");
  const skip = s => `<span class="doi-skip">${s} · ${t.willSkip}</span>`;
  const body = {
    checking: `<span class="doi-checking">${t.checking}</span>`,
    ready: `${kind} <strong>${esc(m.title)}</strong>${line ? `<div class="dataset-meta">${line}</div>` : ""}`,
    inAtlas: `${skip(t.inAtlas)} <strong>${esc(m.title)}</strong>`,
    already: `${skip(`${t.already} (${t.statusNames[it.status] || it.status})`)} <strong>${esc(m.title)}</strong>`,
    notFound: skip(t.notFound),
  }[it.state];
  return `<li class="doi-item ${it.state}"><code>${esc(doi)}</code>${body}</li>`;
}

function render() {
  $("doi-list").innerHTML = [...items].map(([doi, it]) => row(doi, it)).join("");
  const ready = [...items.values()].filter(it => it.state === "ready").length;
  const busy = [...items.values()].some(it => it.state === "checking");
  const tooMany = ready > MAX;
  $("too-many").hidden = !tooMany;
  $("too-many").textContent = fmt(t.tooMany, { max: MAX });
  $("submit-btn").disabled = !ready || busy || tooMany;
  $("submit-btn").textContent = !ready ? t.submitNone : ready === 1 ? t.submitOne : fmt(t.submitMany, { n: ready });
}

let timer;
$("dois").addEventListener("input", () => {
  clearTimeout(timer);
  timer = setTimeout(() => {
    const dois = extractDois($("dois").value);
    for (const d of [...items.keys()]) if (!dois.includes(d)) items.delete(d);
    const fresh = dois.filter(d => !items.has(d));
    fresh.forEach(d => items.set(d, { state: "checking" }));
    render();
    // Check a few at a time; a pasted list of 25 shouldn't fire 25 requests at once
    let i = 0;
    const next = async () => {
      while (i < fresh.length) {
        const d = fresh[i++];
        const res = await check(d);
        if (items.has(d)) { items.set(d, res); render(); }
      }
    };
    Promise.all([next(), next(), next(), next()]);
  }, 400);
});

const say = msg => { $("status").textContent = msg; $("status").hidden = !msg; };

$("submit-form").addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  say("");
  const dois = [...items].filter(([, it]) => it.state === "ready").map(([d]) => d);
  if (!dois.length) return;
  const token = document.querySelector("[name='cf-turnstile-response']")?.value;
  if (!token) return say(t.captcha);
  const btn = $("submit-btn");
  btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = t.sending;
  try {
    const r = await fetch(`${WORKER}/api/submit`, {
      method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ dois, sector: $("sector").value, note: $("note").value,
        contact: $("contact").value, lang, turnstileToken: token })
    });
    const j = await r.json();
    if (!j.ok) throw j;
    showDone(j.results);
  } catch (err) {
    say({ captcha: t.captcha, rate_limited: t.rateLimited,
          too_many: fmt(t.tooMany, { max: MAX }) }[err?.error] || t.error);
    window.turnstile?.reset();
    render();
  }
});

function showDone(results) {
  const added = results.filter(x => x.result === "added");
  $("done-text").textContent = !added.length ? t.doneNone
    : added.length === 1 ? t.doneOne : fmt(t.doneMany, { n: added.length });
  $("done-list").innerHTML = added.map(x => {
    const chip = x.kind === "dataset" ? `<span class="chip kind-dataset">${t.kindDatasetChip}</span>`
                                      : `<span class="chip kind">${t.kindPaperChip}</span>`;
    return `<li class="doi-item ready"><code>${esc(x.doi)}</code>${chip} <strong>${esc(x.title)}</strong></li>`;
  }).join("");
  $("submit-form").hidden = true;
  $("done").hidden = false;
  $("done").focus();
  $("done").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
}

$("again").addEventListener("click", () => {
  $("submit-form").reset();
  items.clear(); render(); say("");
  window.turnstile?.reset();
  $("done").hidden = true;
  $("submit-form").hidden = false;
  $("dois").focus();
});

render();
</script>
